CREATE TABLE "public"."FeeCategory" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "schoolId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."FeePayment" (
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "invoiceId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "paidAt" timestamptz,
  "providerReference" text,
  "recordedByUserId" int4,
  "reference" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "FeePayment_method_check_0f145c4e" CHECK ("method" IN ('CASH', 'BANK_TRANSFER', 'PAYSTACK', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT "FeePayment_status_check_147e2653" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'FAILED', 'REFUNDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."FeeStructure" (
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "categoryId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "classId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "isMandatory" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "schoolId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sessionId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "termId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."InvoiceItem" (
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "categoryId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "invoiceId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."StudentInvoice" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dueDate" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "invoiceNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "issuedAt" timestamptz,
  "schoolId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sessionId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "studentId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "termId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "termInvoiceKey" text,
  "title" text,
  "totalAmount" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "StudentInvoice_status_check_c484ea39" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'ISSUED', 'CANCELLED')),
  CONSTRAINT "StudentInvoice_type_check_f256648a" CHECK ("type" IN ('TERM', 'ONE_OFF'))
)
